It works across video platforms without a clunky meeting bot.
There's a limited free trial, after which it becomes a paid subscription.
slides.narration: Granola is a Mac-first meeting notetaker that transcribes your calls and combines the transcript with your own typed notes into a polished summary. It works across video platforms without a clunky meeting bot. There's a free tier to start.

slides.title: What's cool for NCW
lines: Educators: capture IEP-team or parent meetings, then review and edit the AI summary before sharing (two-eyes rule)
SMB owners: turn a client call into an action list and a follow-up email draft
Community leaders: keep clean, searchable minutes from board and committee meetings
slides.narration: Here's what's cool for our valley. Educators can capture IEP-team or parent meetings, then review and edit the AI summary before sharing (two-eyes rule); SMB owners can turn a client call into an action list and a follow-up email draft; Community leaders can keep clean, searchable minutes from board and committee meetings.

slides.title: The rules — the AiGovOps way
lines: A human on the trigger — you read it before it goes out
Keep the receipts — save your prompt and the answer
Mind the data cost of “free” — no student records, IEPs, or private details in a free tool
slides.narration: Now the rules, the AiGovOps way. Keep a human on the trigger: you read it before it goes out. Keep the receipts: save your prompt and the answer. And mind the data cost of free — never paste student records, an I-E-P, or a customer's private details into a free tool, because free tools learn from what you type.
